summary: Iteration 42 verified (a) new Cafeteria layer end-to-end and (b) the physical move of order/payment/admin routes out of server.py into routers/orders.py and routers/admin.py did not lose or regress any endpoint. 24/24 backend tests pass; frontend Cafeterias tab renders and creates/renames/deletes work.

coverage: TestCafeteriaCRUD (4): list auto-creates default with vendor_count; create/rename/delete flow with 400 on duplicate + empty name; default cannot be deleted (400); default cannot be deactivated (400).

TestOrdersRouter (7): GET /api/config/payment-mode; GET /api/orders returns UTC-aware created_at ending +00:00 for both employee and vendor; POST /api/orders/{id}/mark-paid returns 409 on already-paid; GET /api/admin/orders/reconciliation returns 9 buckets (total/pending/cash/physical_qr/paid/unpaid/ready_for_collection/collected/cancelled) each with {count, amount} + payment_mode; GET /api/orders/last; POST /api/payments/razorpay/checkout-intent route exists (not 404).

TestAdminRouter (10): reconciliation and vendor commission/vendor PATCH + email-log all 403 for non-master; unauth returns 401; sanitize + integrity backfill-orders/sites/employee-sites + employee-menu-report + employee-visibility all 200 for master.
TestCafeteriaVendorAssignment (1): GET /api/sites/{id}/vendors payload exposes cafeteria_id + cafeteria_name.
TestOrderScopingRegression (2): timefix_emp sees exactly 2 orders {CRV-TIMEFIX1, CRV-TIMEFIX2}; vendor sees >=2. Role scoping intact after refactor.

frontend_playwright.cafeterias_tab: PASS - /master/sites/{id} shows tab-cafeterias; clicking renders cafeterias-list with Main Cafeteria (Default badge, no delete button) + Rooftop Garden Cafe + Tower A Food Court. Create via cafeteria-name-input + cafeteria-create-btn added a new row live. Rename via cafeteria-edit-{id} + cafeteria-edit-input-{id} + cafeteria-save-{id} persisted. Delete via cafeteria-delete-{id} removed the row.
frontend_playwright.vendors_tab: Not exercisable on the seed site (Demo Cafeteria Site has 0 mapped vendors). vendor-cafeteria-badge-{id} / vendor-cafeteria-select-{id} / add-vendor-cafeteria-select code paths exist in SiteDetail.js (lines 202/229/277) and the backend API returns cafeteria_id+cafeteria_name so the badge will render as soon as a vendor is mapped. Recommend main-agent seed at least one mapped vendor for future UI regression.

critical_code_review_comments: ensure_default_cafeterias is idempotent and safe on startup; index on (site_id) and (site_id,is_default) created. Good.
routers/cafeterias.py::_can_access_site correctly blocks employees from mutating cafeterias while allowing them read via list_cafeterias.
delete_cafeteria reassigns orphaned vendor_site_mappings back to default before removing the doc - no dangling refs.
routers/orders.py::/admin/orders/reconciliation exposes 9 buckets under a nested `buckets` key plus payment_mode - matches spec.
MINOR: /api/orders/last was not in the review request list but exists and returned 200/404 correctly - kept as-is.

NOTE: RAZORPAY_MOCK_MODE is 'false' in backend/.env (live mode) - could not exercise POST /api/payments/razorpay/verify with a mock signature end-to-end. The route is wired (not 404) and checkout-intent responds. If main agent needs full /verify materialisation test, flip RAZORPAY_MOCK_MODE=true temporarily; the previously validated race-idempotency script at scripts/test_duplicate_order_race.py remains the authoritative proof for that path.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for cafeterias + orders/admin refactor lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter42_cafeterias_refactor.py (24 tests, JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter42_results.xml). Reconciliation endpoint returns nested buckets: {buckets:{total,pending,cash,physical_qr,paid,unpaid,ready_for_collection,collected,cancelled -> {count,amount}}, payment_mode}. TIMEFIX order codes are on field `collection_code`, not `cravitoo_order_id`. Demo site id: 6a9aa2ae325745411d257a08; default cafeteria id: 6a9aa2ae325745411d257a0a.
